admission_price: Free admission to pumpkin patch; inflatable rides $22 for 1 hour (ages 2-12), $27 for 2 hours, $35 all-day pass; under 2 years $10 for 1 hour or $15 for 2 hours; paintball $10 for 16 oz cup, $20 for 40 oz bucket, $40 for 80 oz bucket (cash prices; credit card transactions charged 3.99% fee)
activities: inflatable rides and slides; pumpkin selection and purchase; photo opportunity areas; paintball; duck boats; superslide; petting zoo; pony rides; school field trips; birthday parties; playgroup visits
season_dates: September 13 – October 31, 2025; Monday-Thursday 3-9 pm, Friday 2-9 pm, Saturday/Sunday 10 am-9 pm
extra_notes: Admission to pumpkin patch and parking is free. Socks required on inflatable rides. No reservations needed for walk-ins; groups can book discounted rates. Dogs not allowed; service animals must be leashed. Visitors under 17 must be accompanied by an adult. Outside food/beverages not permitted unless pre-arranged for parties/groups. Non-smoking, non-vape event. Prepackaged snacks and beverages available at ticket kiosk. Birthday party packages available (weekday special $99 for 6 children, weekends $25 per child).
